name: Uptime Institute PUE data - NEGATIVE: 2026 survey behind download wall
price_basis: No price recorded. PUE is a ratio, not a price. The Uptime Institute 2026 survey data is behind a download wall.
notes: NEGATIVE SUPPLY RECORD. The Uptime Institute Global Data Center Survey Results 2026 (16th annual, published July 2026) is the primary industry source for PUE averages, power density trends, and tier distribution. However, the survey data is behind a download wall and was not accessible from the landing page. The existing repo record (pwr2-vantage-power-density) covers Vantage's power density tiers (8.3-20 kW/rack) but not industry-wide PUE data. PUE is a critical cost input for on-prem and colo deployments: a PUE of 1.5 means that for every 1kW of IT load, 0.5kW is spent on cooling and overhead. At scale, the difference between PUE 1.2 and 1.5 can be millions of dollars per year. The Uptime Institute survey is the authoritative source for this data.
